# Readiness reaches the actual daemon directly; every CLI HTTP call is counted.
server start
! skygo artifacts upload missing
stderr 'open snapshot directory'
symlink source/link -> ../outside.txt
! skygo artifacts upload source
stderr 'symlink|ownership or mode'
rm source/link
cmp outside.txt expected-outside.txt
! skygo artifacts download --ref duplicate.json destination
stderr 'duplicate'
! skygo artifacts remove --ref ref.json
stderr 'requires --yes'
! skygo artifacts cancel aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa
stderr 'requires an upload ID and --yes'
! skygo artifacts upload source --resume wrong
stderr 'resume requires an upload ID'
! skygo run -f setup.yaml --request-id invalid-workspace
stderr 'require workdir'
! skygo run -f directory.yaml --request-id invalid-directory
stderr 'empty directory'
mkdir existing
! skygo artifacts download --ref ref.json existing
stderr 'destination already exists'
calls ALL 0
! exists destination native-marker
server stop
! stderr .

setup: [prepare]

directory: /host/path
workdir: {id: aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa, sha256: bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb, size: 2048}
